<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

def main():
    input_path = 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv'
    output_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
    
    # Read the long-format Eurostat data
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path)
    
    # Identify the indicator column (column containing indicator IDs)
    indicator_col = None
    for col in df.columns:
        if 'indicator' in col.lower():
            indicator_col = col
            break
    if indicator_col is None:
        indicator_col = 'indicator_id'
    
    # Identify the value column (column containing indicator values)
    value_col = None
    for col in df.columns:
        if 'value' in col.lower():
            value_col = col
            break
    if value_col is None:
        value_col = 'value'
    
    # Identify identifier columns (city_id, city_name, year)
    identifier_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
    id_cols = [col for col in identifier_cols if col in df.columns]
    
    # Pivot the data: indicator_id becomes columns, values become the cell contents
    pivot_df = df.pivot_table(
        index=id_cols,
        columns=indicator_col,
        values=value_col,
        aggfunc='first'
    )
    
    # Reset index to make identifier columns regular columns
    result_df = pivot_df.reset_index()
    
    # Convert NaN values to empty strings (for absent records)
    result_df = result_df.fillna('')
    
    # Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (pandas handles quoting automatically)
    result_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
</solution_file>
